title: Wastewater irrigation impacts on seed germination and seedling growth of rice (Oryza sativa), tomato (Solanum lycopersicum), and mustard (Brassica napus) crops
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1924-1935
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00324E, Paper
Md. Kamrul Hasan, Mahfuza Pervin, Tushar Kanti Das, Abdur Rakib, Kamrun Nahar Mousomi, Jannat Shopan
Wastewater irrigation inhibits seed germination and seedling growth of crops through generating override ROS and thereby increased seedlings mortality up to 30%.
